g.passage: Harriet, whose father ran the lake ferry, sold tickets at the Strand each winter, when the films were old and the seats mostly empty. g.passage: Dwayne, my brother's tutor, rode the night bus out of Dakar's Plateau with me every Thursday after lessons, and every Thursday he wrote the week's vocabulary on the fogged window with one finger, then wiped it clean before my stop. I took it for a teacher's tic. My brother had stopped answering to the name our grandmother gave him the year we moved, and nobody at home used it now.
